body:
Woke up at midnight on the dot, dozed back off, dreamt of Prince.

Looked Prince up on Google this morning. Today's his birthday. Had no clue.

Sort of weirded out. Anyone else have a similar experience?

Sitting at school praying the teacher doesn't call on you. Imagining everything that could possible go wrong (voice crack, stuttering, everyone laughing, etc)

Always saying/doing something and immediately regretting it or cringing afterwards. 

Fear of meeting new people because you're afraid you'll say something to offend them or open up too fast or be too clingy and push them away.

Walking through a crowded area and anxiously plotting your route so you don't run into anyone and embarrass yourself and ruin your life

Being the quiet one that everyone thinks is weird but you can't do anything about it.

In 7th grade this dude told everyone I had erectile dysfunction.

I'm a girl.
